estimatedFacts.ridingDaysMethod: Count distinct recorded dates with at least 5 miles and 10 minutes at 25–160 km/h, using consecutive fixes at most 5 minutes apart. This infers likely riding but cannot identify the vehicle.
estimatedFacts.distanceMethod: Use the combined full-resolution recorded route distance, rounded once to whole miles. Include local activity; exclude duplicate and overlapping alternate exports. Do not estimate missing segments.

Missing recordings can undercount mileage and riding days.
